Use tab to navigate through the menu items. About The Bloom Station Hello and welcome to The Bloom Station. I’m Sara, and flowers are my thing... ​ The Bloom Station began in 2017 as a pop-up outside Radlett Train Station. From the start, it was built on quality, care, and a strong connection to the local community. Fresh flowers people could rely on became the foundation of The Bloom Station, and that principle still guides everything I do. ​ Today, I work from my studio in Radlett, designing and preparing each bouquet myself. As a trusted Radlett florist, I create luxury flowers that are thoughtfully arranged, well judged, and made to last. Working independently allows me to maintain the standards that matter most. ​ I partner with a small number of respected UK suppliers who source exceptional blooms from around the world. Every stem is conditioned, inspected, and arranged with precision. Nothing leaves the studio unless it meets the level of quality I pride myself on. ​ Customers often tell me my flowers last longer than others they’ve bought before. That’s intentional. Freshness and longevity always come before volume here. Whether it’s an everyday gesture or a significant celebration, each order is approached with care, precision and attention to detail. ​ I look forward to creating something beautiful for you. Sara x​ ​ Home About Contact Behind the scenes Radle

Become a member today! Search About Red De Moda Red De Moda is The Fashion Professional Network. We exist to improve outcomes for people across the fashion industry through opportunity, learning and connection. Our Purpose Supporting the people behind fashion Fashion is one of the most creative industries in the world, yet the people inside it are too often left to navigate their careers alone. Talent goes unseen, careers stall, and brilliant, experienced people struggle to find their next opportunity, while businesses struggle to find them. Red De Moda brings the industry together across three career stages: people getting in, people staying and growing, and senior leaders choosing to work differently. Three career stages. One Red De Moda community. The Gap We Saw Why we created Red De Moda Fashion lacked a credible, central space built for the people who actually work in it. Job platforms are expensive and generic. Events too often feel transactional. Networks are either too broad or too shallow to be genuinely useful. So we built Red De Moda for fashion professionals, by fashion professionals: one place where opportunity, learning and real connection sit side by side, and where everyone is welcome, whatever their gender, age or career stage.
